defect: The published definition restricted the lower-bound parameter of an (ell,w)-blockade to natural numbers, making the real blockade thresholds used in the cited source and in the property-(*) reduction ill-typed.
correction_basis: The source defines an (ell,w)-blockade as an integer-length sequence with actual length t at least ell and repeatedly uses real thresholds such as epsilon^{-1}; allowing real ell>=1 is equivalent to requiring t>=ceil(ell) and preserves every integer instance.
